festival.name: Diwali (Lakshmi Puja)
festival.blessing: माँ लक्ष्मी की कृपा से आपका घर रोशन रहे

posts.flux: A beautifully decorated home altar for Lakshmi Puja: brass diyas, marigold garlands, a silver kalash with mango leaves and a coconut, lotus flowers, a colourful rangoli, glowing warm light, no people

quoteText.dev:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥
quoteText.roman: Yada yada hi dharmasya glanir bhavati Bharata
quoteText.meaning: Jab-jab dharm kamzor hota hai, tab-tab Bhagwan dharm ki raksha ke liye aate hain.
